Scene: a dark espresso bar, polished chrome machine, warm amber key light from the left, deep brown shadows.
Subject: a steel portafilter and a matte black ceramic cup on the drip tray.
Action:
0-2s: extreme close-up, a hand locks the portafilter into the machine with one firm twist.
2-6s: two thin streams of espresso begin to flow in slow motion, tiger-striped and golden, thickening as they fall.
6-8s: the streams land in the matte black ceramic cup, golden crema swirling and settling on the surface.
Camera: extreme close-up, eye level, 85mm macro lens feel, shallow depth of field, slow tilt-down following the streams, rack focus from the spout to the surface of the cup.
Lighting and texture: warm amber backlight that makes the streams glow like honey, soft reflections sliding across the chrome, fine steam.
Audio: low pump hum, liquid trickling into ceramic.
End on: the top of the matte black ceramic cup filled with dark espresso and golden crema. Clean unbranded frame.

Настройки: формат 9:16, 8 секунд, звук включён.

3. lens
4. one move
